content: 1. Remove the following templates: Configure Lucene search instead of the built-in MediaWiki search. This task is currently in progress. 2. Import images from Gray's Anatomy. 3. Add support for uploading and playing Flash videos. 4. Do not remove unnecessary inter-language links from all pages. Instead, place them within statements to hide them. This modification will only apply to category pages, while real pages will remain unchanged. 5. Clean up the Special:BrokenRedirects page. Proposal 1: Remove the redirect tag and replace it with a help menu and source acknowledgment. Proposal 2: Delete the page. 6. Clean up category lists. Rename Category:Medical emergencies to Category:Emergency medicine. Remove all links to the category on all pages and delete the category page if it exists. 7. Clean up broken image links. Import some images from Wikipedia and delete references to others. 8. Clean up broken page links. For example, in Special:WantedPages, de-wikify the link and replace it with the displayed text. 9. Remove references to templates that do not exist. This task has been completed. 10. Add all diseases listed in the List of genetic disorders to the Category:Genetic Disease. This task is currently running. 11. Add the template language from {{WikiDoc Quick Start}} to the top of each page. This task has been completed. 12. Edit the MediaWiki tagline text and reduce its font size. The font size was changed from 92% to 82%. The tagline display is now restricted to the main namespace, so it does not appear on Help or Special pages (e.g., the user login page). 13. Fix markup tags to ensure functionality. Pages viewed prior to the fix need to be corrected by clicking edit and then save. This action regenerates math images, which are generated once per save event. 14. Implement a Python bot to enable search-and-replace functionality for article text. This task has been completed. 15. Delete the Basic Instructions for Editing this Page sections. This task has been completed. 16. Remove references to {{cleanup|}} templates. This task is in progress. 17. Replace C.D. with C.D. (specific context unclear). This task is in progress. 18. Fix citations. This task has been completed. 19. Add the template {{WikiDoc Sources}} to the bottom of each page. This task is in progress. 20. Add the template {{WikiDoc Help Menu}} to the bottom of each page, before {{WikiDoc Sources}}. This task is in progress. 21. Rename (merge) Category:Emergency_Medicine to Category:Emergency_medicine. This task has been completed. 22. Fix navigation box templates. This task has been completed. 23. Change all entries in the Category:Blood disorders to Category:Hematology. This task has been completed. 24. Change all entries in the Category:Skin diseases to Category:Dermatology. This task has been completed. 25. Add a specific template to every page in the Category:Cardiology. The template should be placed below the infobox at the top of the page. This task is in progress. Pages without an infobox have been completed, while the rest will be addressed next. Subcategories of Cardiology (e.g., Hematology) are not included recursively, as some pages may not belong in the category, while others should be included. Work is ongoing on a per-subcategory basis.
